parsed.note_claim: The cake is revani, a traditional Turkish semolina cake soaked in sugar syrup as part of the standard recipe for its moist texture and taste.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Basbousa ( Arabic : بسبوسة , romanized : basbūsah , also known as harisa , nammoura , or revani ) is a sweet, syrup-soaked semolina dessert
parsed.reason: The page confirms that revani is an alternative name for basbousa, describes it as a syrup-soaked semolina dessert, and elsewhere identifies revani as a Turkish variation.
